context.geography: China is the host in every chart. Germany is shown separately from the overlapping EU27 aggregate. Historical EU membership, UK and Norwegian populations remain distinct; no all-Europe total is calculated.
context.interpretation: Company counts, affiliate entities and branch locations are distinct. U.S. parents and ultimately EU-controlled enterprises are not matched ownership populations; BEA and Eurostat levels must not be used to rank otherwise comparable business presence.
context.question: How has U.S. and European business presence in China changed over time?
context.release_timing: As checked October 22, 2026, BEA's latest activity release covers 2023. The published schedule puts the 2024 activity release on November 20, 2026; no 2024 value is inferred.
context.rights: Publish aggregate statistics and original charts only; raw workbooks and reports remain local. Sources and retrieval checksums accompany every observation.

bea_affiliates:china.label: United States
bea_affiliates:china.notes: Entities, not unique parent companies, offices or storefronts. U.S. parents are U.S.-resident, not necessarily ultimately U.S.-owned. Includes holding companies. Nonbank coverage before 2009; reporting cutoffs $7m through 2003, $10m in 2004-2008, $25m from 2009. Counts exclude benchmark-exempt affiliates. Lines break at benchmark regimes.
bea_affiliates:china.scope: Foreign affiliates in mainland China, excluding Hong Kong and Macau; combined U.S.-parent ownership over 50%

bea_parents:china.label: United States
bea_parents:china.notes: Benchmark observations only, not an annual census. A parent is counted once per host country/region, but can appear in both China and Europe: never add these counts. Country attribution and reporting exclusions follow each benchmark. Not restricted to ultimately American-owned companies. Do not substitute majority-owned affiliate counts for parent counts.
bea_parents:china.scope: Distinct U.S.-resident parent companies with affiliates in China; at least 10% foreign-affiliate ownership; BEA reporting exclusions apply

bundesbank_germany:china.label: Germany (Bundesbank)
bundesbank_germany:china.notes: Direct or indirect control above 50%; affiliates with total assets above EUR 3 million, including branches and permanent establishments. Excludes agriculture, public administration and private households. Not distinct German parent companies, all European businesses or a reconstruction of confidential EU totals.
bundesbank_germany:china.scope: Foreign affiliates in China, excluding separately coded Hong Kong and Macao, ultimately controlled by German investors; NACE Rev. 2 BTSXO

eurostat_affiliates:china.label: EU27 (current members)
eurostat_affiliates:china.notes: Eurostat enterprise units, not unique European parents or all Europe. Macao is a separate partner. Not matched to BEA's size cutoff, U.S.-resident parent basis or consolidation. EBS methodology changes from 2021; do not join across that boundary or treat confidential cells as zero.
eurostat_affiliates:china.scope: China except Hong Kong; ultimately controlled from fixed EU27_2020 membership, excluding the UK; market producers NACE B-S except O

eurostat_germany:china.label: Germany (Eurostat)
eurostat_germany:china.notes: Eurostat's reported history is retained separately from Bundesbank's current workbook. Overlapping 2021-2023 counts differ; they are not spliced, averaged or treated as a matched revision. The 2021 EBS methodology boundary is disconnected. Germany overlaps the EU27 aggregate.
eurostat_germany:china.scope: German-controlled enterprises in China except Hong Kong; Eurostat NACE B-S except O

eurostat_historical_eu:china.label: EU27 (2007 members)
eurostat_historical_eu:china.notes: Historical EU membership, not the current EU27. NACE Rev. 1.1 through 2009 and Rev. 2 from 2010; both classification and membership boundaries remain disconnected. No splice into current-membership counts.
eurostat_historical_eu:china.scope: China except Hong Kong; EU27_2007 control, including the UK and excluding Croatia

eurostat_norway:china.label: Norway
eurostat_norway:china.notes: Norway is outside the EU and is shown separately, not added to an all-Europe total. Eurostat's 2021 methodology boundary is disconnected.
eurostat_norway:china.scope: Norwegian-controlled enterprises in China except Hong Kong; NACE B-S except O

eurostat_uk:china.label: United Kingdom
eurostat_uk:china.notes: Eurostat historical UK series and revised ONS 2018/2019 estimates. Source and sector boundary in 2018 is disconnected; ONS total activity includes agriculture. The 2018 China count agrees across both sources. No UK outward affiliate statistics from 2020 onward verified; investment flows are not substituted.
eurostat_uk:china.scope: UK-controlled enterprises in China; Eurostat NACE B-S except O through 2017, ONS total published activity in 2018-2019

ssb_norway:china.label: Norway
ssb_norway:china.notes: Statistics Norway's own complete country history. All-industry coverage is broader than the old Eurostat B-S except O series; those values are preserved separately, not spliced. Counts are subsidiary enterprises, not unique Norwegian parents or physical offices.
ssb_norway:china.scope: Subsidiary enterprises in China, separately from Hong Kong and Macao, under direct or indirect Norwegian control; all industries
